Remark
[Components of the Lichnerowicz Laplacian] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0298 1. Equation A.4\group second-order-differential-operators

If $A$ is a symmetric $(2,0)$-tensor, then \[ \Delta _L A = \left(\Delta A_{ij} + 2g^{kp}g^{\ell q}R_{ik\ell j}A_{pq} - g^{k\ell }R_{ik}A_{\ell j} - g^{k\ell }R_{jk}A_{\ell i}\right)\, dx^i \otimes dx^j . \]
